name: Willow
bio: Archetype: DoT, Poison Enhance. ⌽ Skills convert [Poison] into [Hag's Bane], a unique poison with increasing damage over time. ⌽ Inflicts [Poison] when allies actively attack. ⌽ Ultimate causes Channel status. When channeling, Moxie cap is raised and she gains additional Moxie for every move. At turn end, consumes increasing amounts Moxie to inflict [Hag's Bane] on all enemies based on Channel duration. On losing all Moxie, deals additional damage to all enemies based on their [Hag's Bane] count and exit the Channel state. ⌽ Requires Tuesday to function properly, loses two thirds of her damage potential without Tuesday.
